leads.arxiv: 2409.20222 (arXiv API: v1 2024-09-30; title: Beyond Prompts: Dynamic Conversational Benchmarking of Large Language Models)

phase1_classification.kind_reason: Dynamic conversational benchmark (NeurIPS 2024 D&B) that tests long-term memory, continual learning and information integration in one long interleaved conversation. Repo datasets include colours, name_list and shopping (repeated value or list changes, then asks for the current state), plus prospect
